channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Jensen Beach teen Harper Aberman to represent Team USA at Sailing World Championship in France
item.description: A Jensen Beach teenager will represent Team USA at the Sailing World Championship in France this weekend, following years of competitive sailing that started when she was four years old. Harper Aberman first discovered the sport at a summer camp in Pennsylvania that her grandparents enrolled her in.

item.title: Palm Beach County homeowners face thousands in surprise sewer bills from Delray Beach audit
item.description: Residents in an unincorporated Palm Beach County neighborhood are grappling with unexpected retroactive sewer bills from the city of Delray Beach, with some bills exceeding $4,000. item.title: Martin County to open manufactured home repair funding portal in August
item.description: Martin County Human Services will open an online application portal in August for manufactured homeowners seeking emergency repairs and storm-hardening retrofits under a new state law that took effect Wednesday.

item.title: Manufactured home owners can apply for Florida's $167 million repair funding starting in August
item.description: Nearly 140 new Florida laws took effect Wednesday, including one that could be a game-changer for some of the state's most vulnerable homeowners. Senate Bill 594 opens up $167 million in state affordable housing funding to help mobile and manufactured home owners pay for emergency repairs and storm-hardening retrofits.

item.title: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach offers sea turtle nesting season programs through September
item.description: The center is offering educational and interactive programs during peak sea turtle nesting season, including guided Turtle Walks, the Hatchling Discovery Program and Hatchling Releases.

item.description:

item.title: Driver held teens at gunpoint after they shot Orbeez pellets at his car in Port St. Lucie
item.description: A driver held teenagers at gunpoint in Port St. Lucie after they shot Orbeez pellets at his car, police say.

item.title: New artificial reef project planned at Sebastian Inlet State Park
item.description: Sebastian Inlet State Park will receive a new artificial reef as part of an environmental enhancement project.
